projection: Explicit #46 MVP_FIELD_CONTRACT allowlist. Group Id/Title/Purpose/ExchangeType/LanguageFocus/CultureFocus/Capacity/State -> groupId/name/purpose/exchangeType/languageFocus/cultureFocus/capacity/state; physical counts -> memberCount/freeSlots; Members use approved person schema. Account Title only -> displayName; no email/Claims/raw Person, audit, validation/migration/availability fields or source/episode/processing/write-owner keys. Group expectedETag is the only row revision/control marker, limited to quoted integer or weak quoted integer; not authority. Group/membership/profile raw objects never serialized. Own-group membershipId is the positive system Id of ONLY the caller's exact operational committed episode, selected by current group from Own_episodes. Other members' membership IDs and Left/provisional episode IDs are never public. This necessary Leave intent reference is not authority.
membershipAuthority: Filter MembershipStatus=Active rows; empty LeftAt, group SetupComplete true, exactly one Accepted+OperationComplete Personal source linked by SourceRequestId, exact MembershipKey request:<id>:participant:<member> bound to an Accepted+OperationComplete episode. Personal episode must be the group source and participant one of its parties. Group episode must target exact group with sender=member and recipient=null. Duplicate Active group/participant episodes fail, never choose first. No leader.
currentAndHistory: Left/nonempty LeftAt/uncommitted/provisional/mismatched/missing-source groups do not grant own current audience. Own committed Active links in Open/Closed/Ended remain visible; Ended preserved by explicit owner #64 direction. Paused/Inactive/closed-to-connections or validation status never erases committed memberships. No rejoin, reopen, state mutation or notifications. Waiting/In a group derived from returned current groups, not raw membership count.
capacity: memberCount counts ALL physical MembershipStatus=Active rows for each returned group, including provisional, paused and nonempty LeftAt anomalies; public members include only committed operational empty-LeftAt episodes. Left excluded from count. Capacity/SourceRequestId are existing Number columns: reject fractional values and normalize integral native numbers before count/key/projection. Language capacity 2-3; Culture/Combined 2-10. Overfull -> CAPACITY_INTEGRITY/[]; no negative slots, silent clamp or slot release.
profileDisplayAdapter: Direct typed display projection, not discovery or compatibility. Resolve complete catalogue labels including inactive/history labels; deduplicate repeated lookup IDs for display only. Missing referenced label/profile/zone fails closed. Optional null/omitted selections/timezone/text allowed. Explicit profile fields are Id, Participantaccount/Title, four lookup Id/results sets, TimezoneId, Learningfocus, Comments; do not read eligibility/status/account-claims fields.
